reasoning: Every nonreverting purchase follows the only implementation path: a positive overflow-bounded count n produces [T+1,T+n], stores that range once under one new ticket ID, and performs one fully traced ERC721 safe mint. Refund arithmetic uses last-first+1 and winner containment rejects only values strictly outside the range, proving both endpoints are included. Inherited owner/operator transfer paths change ownership through Raffle._update without changing the range. All branches that omit these steps revert, so the requirement is implemented rather than partial or contradicted.
